sign: Up: Gildcrest. Down: Brightledge. Sideways: not advised.
sign_2: Nine hundred steps of white stone. The Gilt House counts them every morning, in case one went missing.
step_counter: Wendel: Four hundred and twelve. Don't talk to me, I'll lose count. Then they'll count me.
step_counter_intro: Wendel: You made me lose count. Now we fight, and then I start again.
